onboarding.subtitle: Complete these steps to offer size charts and fit guidance on your store.

onboarding.step2Desc: Link size charts to specific products, collections, or create matching rules.
onboarding.step3Desc: Style the trigger button, modal window, tables, and colors to match your brand.
onboarding.step4Title: 4. Add the Size Guide to your Product Page
onboarding.step4Desc: Ensure the Wix Site Plugin is placed on your product pages.
onboarding.step5Desc: Test desktop and mobile displays with real-time size selection.
onboarding.step6Desc: Help shoppers calculate their recommended size based on measurements.
